title: Hedge fund recruits memory champion Nelson Dellis to remote view the stock market
place_text: United States (contacted via a memory Facebook group)

tellings.quote: To see if I if I'd be willing to be trained in remote viewing in order to remote view the stock market for them.

plain: Around 2022 or 2023, a hedge fund, a private investment firm, reached out to a memory champion named Nelson Dellis through a Facebook group about memory and asked whether he would be trained in remote viewing, the claimed ability to sense distant or hidden things with the mind, "in order to remote view the stock market for them." The guest Chris Ramsay tells this on American Alchemy, Jesse Michels's podcast, passing on what Dellis told him, and also names a man called Brett Stewart. If true, it would mean that money managers take psychic forecasting seriously enough to recruit for it.
